name: Separable 3D Transfer Function Editor
definition: A user interface technique that separates a 3D transfer function space into a 2D domain and associated 1D domains to improve usability while maintaining classification precision.
summary: The Separable 3D Transfer Function Editor decomposes 3D transfer functions into 2D and 1D domains, enabling intuitive interaction via lasso tools and linked 1D editors while allowing simultaneous, independent refinements for multiple 2D widgets.
